retirement_age.notes: The 2023 pension reform raises the statutory age from 62 to 64. Under the Social Security Financing Act for 2026 this increase is suspended until 2028. From 1 September 2026, age 64 applies only to people born from 1969; for generations 1964 to 1968 the legal age lies between 62 years 9 months and 63 years 9 months.
